references.category: Trade Terms & International Sale of Goods
references.name: Incoterms 2020
references.relevance: Provides internationally recognized trade terms for delivery obligations, cost allocation, risk transfer, and export/import clearance responsibility.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When delivery terms or clearance responsibility are unclear, the demo flags that the contract should specify the agreed Incoterms rule and allocation of export/import obligations.
references.limitations: Incoterms do not replace the full sales contract and do not determine sanctions, export control, payment risk, IP, or dispute resolution.
references.updateFrequency: Check ICC source before each real transaction or contract template update

references.category: Trade Terms & International Sale of Goods
references.name: United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG)
references.relevance: Relevant to international sale of goods, contract formation, seller and buyer obligations, conformity of goods, and remedies.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When governing law or international sale-of-goods terms are unclear, the demo flags the need to review whether CISG may apply or should be excluded or modified.
references.limitations: CISG only applies where applicable by contracting states, choice of law, or private international law; parties may exclude it.
references.updateFrequency: Check before finalizing governing law and sales contract language

references.name: United Nations Security Council Consolidated List
references.relevance: Official UN consolidated list for sanctions designations adopted by the Security Council.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When buyer, destination, end user, intermediary, or payment facts create sanctions concern, the rule flags manual screening against current UN sanctions data.
references.limitations: The demo does not query UN live data and does not determine whether a party is listed. Manual screening against current official sources is required.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction

references.name: EU Sanctions Map
references.relevance: Provides official EU sanctions regime information and legal acts by country or measure.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When EU sanctions exposure may be relevant, the demo flags manual review of applicable EU sanctions regimes and legal acts.
references.limitations: The demo does not query the EU Sanctions Map live and does not determine whether a transaction is restricted.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction involving EU nexus or EU sanctions-sensitive facts

references.name: EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List
references.relevance: Official EU reference for individuals, groups, and organisations subject to EU financial sanctions.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When sanctions screening is missing or EU nexus exists, the demo flags manual screening against current EU consolidated financial sanctions data.
references.limitations: The demo does not query EU live data and does not determine whether a party is sanctioned.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction

references.name: The UK Sanctions List
references.relevance: Official UK list of designated persons and specified ships subject to UK sanctions.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When UK sanctions exposure may be relevant, the demo flags manual restricted-party screening against the current UK Sanctions List.
references.limitations: The demo does not query UK live data and does not determine whether a party is sanctioned.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction involving UK nexus or UK sanctions-sensitive facts

references.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
references.officialSource: U.S. Department of the Treasury - OFAC
references.relevance: Used as an official reference point for restricted-party and sanctions screening where U.S. sanctions exposure may be relevant.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When sanctions screening is not completed, or where payment currency, bank, buyer, end user, or destination may create U.S. sanctions exposure, the rule flags manual sanctions screening using current official lists.
references.limitations: The demo does not query OFAC live data and does not determine whether a party is sanctioned. Manual screening against current official sources is required.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction

references.name: OFAC Sanctions List Service
references.officialSource: U.S. Department of the Treasury - OFAC
references.relevance: Provides access to OFAC sanctions list data, including SDN and non-SDN consolidated list data.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When sanctions screening is missing, the demo flags that current OFAC list data should be checked manually or through an approved compliance workflow.
references.limitations: The demo does not download OFAC data, call an API, or determine sanctions status.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction

references.name: Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China
references.officialSource: National People's Congress / official Chinese legal sources
references.relevance: Relevant to export-control obligations of Chinese exporters, controlled items, end-user and end-use review, and licence-related analysis.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: For Chinese sellers exporting power equipment or heavy machinery, the demo flags manual export-control classification and end-use/end-user screening.
references.limitations: The demo does not classify products, determine licence requirements, or replace Chinese export-control legal review.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction and after regulatory updates

references.name: Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
references.officialSource: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security / eCFR
references.relevance: Relevant where U.S.-origin items, U.S. technology, U.S. persons, reexports, or other U.S. export-control nexus may be involved.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When technical documents, technology origin, destination, end use, or end user may create export-control concerns, the demo flags manual EAR analysis if applicable.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine EAR applicability, ECCN, licence exception, or licence requirement.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction with possible U.S. export-control nexus

references.name: Commerce Control List (CCL)
references.officialSource: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security / eCFR
references.relevance: Relevant to classifying controlled dual-use items and technology under the EAR.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When products or technical information may involve dual-use characteristics, the demo flags manual classification review against the current CCL.
references.limitations: The demo does not assign ECCNs or determine whether an item is controlled.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction with possible U.S. export-control nexus

references.name: BIS ECCN Classification Guidance
references.officialSource: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security
references.relevance: Provides official guidance for Commerce Control List classification and ECCN review.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When the product may involve controlled technology, the demo flags manual ECCN/classification work rather than making a licence conclusion.
references.limitations: The demo does not classify ECCNs, determine licence exceptions, or replace BIS guidance review.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each classification review

references.name: EU Dual-Use Export Control Regulation
references.relevance: Relevant where EU dual-use export-control rules or EU-origin technology may be implicated.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: Used as a placeholder authority reference when EU export-control nexus needs manual analysis.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine EU dual-use classification or licence requirements.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction with possible EU nexus

references.name: UK Strategic Export Controls
references.relevance: Relevant where UK-origin goods, technology, software, parties, or other UK export-control nexus may be involved.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: Used as a placeholder authority reference when UK export-control nexus needs manual analysis.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine UK control-list classification or licence requirements.
references.updateFrequency: Check before each real transaction with possible UK nexus

references.name: FATF Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators
references.relevance: Relevant to third-party payment, inconsistent trade documents, unusual payment routes, and mismatch between goods, value, country, and payment party.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When payment structure creates AML or trade-based money-laundering red flags, the demo flags enhanced due diligence and manual review.
references.limitations: Risk indicators are not conclusive evidence of money laundering; they only indicate the need for enhanced due diligence.
references.updateFrequency: Check before enhanced due diligence or AML control updates

references.name: IEC 60076 Power Transformers
references.relevance: Relevant to transformer technical specifications, testing, acceptance standards, and conformity of goods.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When IEC standards are selected or technical standards are unclear, the demo flags that the applicable standard and acceptance criteria must be contractually specified.
references.limitations: The demo does not assess engineering compliance or certify product conformity. It only flags that technical standards and acceptance criteria must be specified.
references.updateFrequency: Check before technical appendix and acceptance clauses are finalized

references.name: ANSI / IEEE Transformer Standards
references.relevance: Placeholder reference for transformer technical standards where ANSI/IEEE standards are selected by the parties.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When ANSI or IEEE standards are referenced, the demo flags the need to identify exact standard numbers, editions, tests, and acceptance criteria.
references.limitations: The demo does not verify the correct standard, edition, or technical conformity.
references.updateFrequency: Check before technical appendix and acceptance clauses are finalized

references.name: GB Transformer Standards
references.officialSource: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information
references.relevance: Placeholder reference for Chinese GB standards applicable to transformers or industrial electrical equipment.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When GB standards are referenced, the demo flags the need to identify exact standard numbers, editions, tests, and acceptance criteria.
references.limitations: The demo does not verify the correct GB standard, edition, or product conformity.
references.updateFrequency: Check before technical appendix and acceptance clauses are finalized

references.name: WIPO Madrid System
references.relevance: Relevant to international trademark registration and trademark-related checks in OEM/private-label exports.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When OEM/private label or buyer trademark use is involved, the demo flags trademark authorization and jurisdiction-specific IP review.
references.limitations: The demo does not verify trademark ownership, registration, validity, or infringement risk.
references.updateFrequency: Check before using buyer marks or shipping branded goods

references.name: Trademark Authorization Review
references.officialSource: Contract and jurisdiction-specific IP counsel review
references.relevance: Relevant where buyer trademarks, private labels, packaging, nameplates, or logos are used on exported equipment.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: The demo flags the need to obtain written authorization and confirm who bears responsibility for trademark clearance.
references.limitations: This is a review workflow placeholder rather than a single official database. Jurisdiction-specific legal review is required.
references.updateFrequency: Check for each OEM/private-label transaction

references.name: OEM / IP / Confidentiality Contract Review
references.officialSource: Contract and jurisdiction-specific IP counsel review
references.relevance: Relevant to ownership of drawings, designs, technical documentation, confidentiality, non-use, and reverse-engineering restrictions.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When drawings, design files, technical documents, or customization are involved, the demo flags the need for IP and confidentiality clauses.
references.limitations: This is a review workflow placeholder and does not determine IP ownership or enforceability.
references.updateFrequency: Check for each customized or technology-documentation transaction

references.name: Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York Convention, 1958)
references.relevance: Relevant to enforcement of foreign arbitral awards and arbitration clause design in cross-border contracts.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When dispute-resolution terms are missing or unclear, the demo flags review of arbitration seat, institution, language, and enforcement strategy.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine enforceability of a specific clause or arbitral award. Jurisdiction-specific legal review is required.
references.updateFrequency: Check before finalizing dispute-resolution clauses

references.name: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration
references.relevance: Relevant to arbitration framework, arbitral procedure, and seat-law analysis in international commercial disputes.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When arbitration or dispute resolution is unclear, the demo flags manual review of seat, institution, procedure, and enforceability context.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine whether a jurisdiction has adopted the Model Law or whether a specific clause is enforceable.
references.updateFrequency: Check before finalizing dispute-resolution clauses

references.name: European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses for International Transfers
references.relevance: Relevant where EU personal data may be transferred across borders in customer, employee, supplier, or technical contact data.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When cross-border data transfer is selected, the demo flags review of applicable data transfer mechanism, SCCs, notices, and safeguards.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine whether a data transfer is lawful or whether SCCs are sufficient.
references.updateFrequency: Check before any real cross-border transfer of personal data

references.name: China PIPL Cross-Border Personal Information Transfer Review
references.officialSource: Cyberspace Administration of China / Chinese data protection authorities
references.relevance: Relevant where personal information collected or processed in China may be transferred overseas.
references.howToUseInThisDemo: When customer, employee, supplier, or technical contact data may cross borders, the demo flags review of applicable PIPL transfer mechanisms, notices, consent, security assessment, certification, or standard contract.
references.limitations: The demo does not determine whether a data transfer is lawful. Current Chinese data-transfer rules and official guidance must be manually verified.
references.updateFrequency: Check before any real cross-border transfer of personal information
